description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) and input classes for updating event types, including nested classes for options, sources, views, variants, recurring events, interval limits, and booking fields. It also imports constants, decorators, and enums used for validation and API documentation.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Represents a selectable option with a value and label.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Defines a source with optional edit URL and field requirement flag.

classes.name: View
classes.description: Represents a view with an ID, label, and optional description.

classes.name: OptionsInput
classes.description: Defines input options for a form field, including type, requirement, and placeholder.

classes.name: VariantField
classes.description: Represents a field within a variant, including type, name, label, placeholder, and requirement.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Contains an array of VariantFields, representing a variant configuration.

classes.name: VariantsConfig
classes.description: Holds a record of variants keyed by string identifiers.

classes.name: BookingField_2024_04_15
classes.description: Defines a booking field with properties like type, name, options, labels, variants, views, and flags for UI behavior.

classes.name: RecurringEvent_2024_04_15
classes.description: Represents a recurring event with start date, interval, count, frequency, until date, and timezone.

classes.name: IntervalLimits_2024_04_15
classes.description: Specifies limits per day, week, month, and year for booking or duration intervals.

classes.name: UpdateEventTypeInput_2024_04_15
classes.description: Main input class for updating event types, including properties like length, slug, title, description, location, booking fields, and various flags.
